segments.title: Antarctica is #1. What's the 2nd BIGGEST desert?
segments.say: Antarctica is the biggest desert on Earth. So what's number two? Sahara, Arctic, or Gobi? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's the Arctic!
segments.say: It's the Arctic! Another cold one.

segments.title: Both top spots are COLD
segments.say: Britannica lists the Antarctic first and the Arctic second. Both are frozen.

segments.title: The Sahara still wins one title
segments.say: The Sahara still wins one title: the biggest hot desert on Earth.
